purpose: Teach: 文体/電動/見送り/例文/厚み/大きめ/学費/利上げ

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: マニュアル、文体、固すぎ。やわらかくしよう。
lines.en: The manual's style is too stiff. Let's soften it.
lines.style: Brisk, matter-of-fact delivery. Decisive tone, no hesitation. Taps out the problem like she's checking a box. Moves forward without dwelling.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。事務所の電動シャッター、点検、依頼しました。
lines.en: Done. I've requested an inspection for the office power shutter.
lines.style: Clean, cooperative. Clipped affirmative at the start. Steady rhythm like reading off a checklist. No color — just efficient confirmation.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 外部講師、見送りの判断、急がねば。
lines.en: The external lecturer decision—we need to move on that quickly.
lines.style: Directive, slightly pressed for time. Small lift of urgency on the opening. Pace picks up slightly. Leaves an expectant pause at the end.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。FAQの例文、追加しました。
lines.en: Done. I've added the example sentences to the FAQ.
lines.style: Same cooperative rhythm as before. Quiet confidence—he's checked this off too. Brief, warm affirmation. No strain.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: カタログ、厚み出して、高級感を。
lines.en: The catalog needs more substance—give it that premium weight.
lines.style: Specific, intentional. Slight emphasis on the direction—she knows exactly what she wants. Confident, not demanding. Brief and clean.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。試作品、大きめのサイズで作りました。
lines.en: Done. I had the prototype made in a larger size.
lines.style: Same steady baseline as before. Understated—no drama about execution. Reliable rhythm. He's built up a pattern of saying yes and delivering.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 社員子弟の学費補助、評判いいね。
lines.en: That employee tuition aid program's getting good feedback.
lines.style: Shift in tone—warmer now, almost pleased. Lighter pace. The words land like noticing something that went right. Genuine, not performative brightness.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。日銀の利上げ、影響、注視しています。
lines.en: Yes. We're closely watching how the BoJ rate hike affects us.
lines.style: Attentive, measured. Returns to the careful listening posture. Quiet focus—the kind that doesn't rush to conclusion. Slight forward lean in the voice.
